Built for Speed, Designed for Trust

PORTEX was founded in 2021 in Gurugram with one mission: make porter logistics as reliable as a bank transfer. Today we operate across 50+ cities with a fleet of AI-assisted porters, four vehicle classes, and a proprietary neural dispatch engine.

We believe delivery pricing should never be a surprise. Our upfront fare guarantee means the price you see before booking is exactly the price you pay — always.
